prestated.H1: Spearman(T, rate) stays within [0.55, 0.85] on balanced draws at bitlen 56, u=2.5.
prestated.H1_rule: PASS iff point estimate rho_T lies in [0.55, 0.85]; bootstrap 95% CI reported alongside.
prestated.H2: T beats count<=100 by > +0.05 (advantage = rho_T - rho_count).
prestated.H2_rule: PASS iff advantage > +0.05 AND bootstrap 95% CI lower bound of advantage > 0.

design.population: 1200 balanced semiprimes; p,q distinct uniform primes in [ceil(2^27.5), 2^28-1]; guarantees bitlen(N)=56 exactly.
design.draws: per N: 240 relation values v = isqrt(N)+1+offset with offset ~ Uniform{0..W-1}, W = round(N**0.25) (QS-style window above sqrt).
design.dial_B: B = exp(ln(vmed)/u), u=2.5; vmed = median of that N's 240 v values (so u = ln(vmed)/ln(B) exactly, per design line).
design.hit: rem = v*v - N; strip primes <= B ascending; HIT iff rem==1 after strip or leftover prime cofactor <= B (early-break rescue); maxp<=B checked literally on every hit.
design.features_paper164_verbatim: T(N) = sum over odd primes p<=400 with Euler criterion powmod(N,(p-1)//2,p)==1 of 2/p ; count(N) = #{odd primes q<=100 : Euler criterion ==1} (odd-only, mirroring T's definition).
design.stats: Spearman rho(T,rate), rho(count,rate), advantage=rho_T-rho_count; bootstrap 300 resamples (seed SEED+2), percentile 95% CIs.
design.rng_split: Random(SEED) population, Random(SEED+1) draw offsets, Random(SEED+2) bootstrap.

barrier_lines.(5): which-factor wall untouched: T and count are factor-BLIND relation-rate predictors; no which-factor or symmetric-channel reading computed anywhere in this experiment.
barrier_lines.(8): toy-scale scope: bitlen-56 semiprimes only; no poly(log N) or subexponential route claimed; rank correlations do not extrapolate beyond the measured regime.

caveats: window law W=round(N**0.25) with uniform offsets chosen here from the design line; paper-177's exact draw law was not restatable in-isolation, so rate LEVELS may differ while the rank correlations remain the comparanda
count<=100 excludes p=2, mirroring the odd-only definition of T
u=2.5 realized per design (B keyed to vmed); effective u on the remainder scale reported separately in sampling.effective_u_on_rem_median
